title: Returns
body: You can return an item within 30 days of delivery. Start a return from Orders, then print the label we email you.

title: Refunds
body: A refund reaches your card 5 to 7 business days after the warehouse receives the return.

title: Shipping times
body: Standard shipping takes 3 to 5 business days. Express shipping takes 1 to 2 business days.

title: Tracking an order
body: Every shipped order has a tracking number. It appears on the order page once the carrier scans the parcel.

title: Cancelling an order
body: You can cancel an order until it ships. After that, return it instead.
